name: Kavita
description: Ebook, comic and manga server with built-in readers for every format, OPDS, user libraries and reading lists.
compose:
services:
  kavita:
    image: kavitareader/server:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:5000"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/kavita/config
      - /books:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
